import pandas as pd
import re

def clean_money(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return 0
    s=str(x)
    # keep digits
    digits=re.sub(r'["'^'"\\d]', '', s)
    return int(digits) if digits else 0

file='national_programme_ledger.xlsx'

# Lookup
lookup_raw=pd.read_excel(file, sheet_name='Cost Centre Lookup', header=None)
lookup_df=lookup_raw.iloc[4:].copy()
lookup_df.columns=lookup_raw.iloc[3].tolist()
lookup_df=lookup_df.dropna(subset=['Cost Centre Code'])
lookup_df['norm_code']=lookup_df['Cost Centre Code'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
lookup_df=lookup_df[['norm_code','Programme','State']]

# Field Expenses
fe_raw=pd.read_excel(file, sheet_name='Field Expenses', header=None)
fe_header=fe_raw.iloc[4].tolist()
fe_df=fe_raw.iloc[5:].copy()
fe_df.columns=fe_header
fe_df=fe_df.dropna(subset=['Transaction ID'])
fe_df['norm_cc']=fe_df['Cost Centre'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
fe_df['norm_status']=fe_df['Posting Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
fe_df=fe_df[fe_df['norm_status']=='posted']
fe_df['Amount_num']=fe_df['Amount (INR)'].apply(clean_money)
fe_merged=fe_df.merge(lookup_df, left_on='norm_cc', right_on='norm_code', how='inner')
fe_merged=fe_merged[(fe_merged['Programme'].str.strip().str.lower()=='maternal and child health') & (fe_merged['State'].str.strip().str.lower()=='odisha')]
total_fe=fe_merged['Amount_num'].sum()

# Salary
sr_raw=pd.read_excel(file, sheet_name='Salary Register', header=None)
sr_header=sr_raw.iloc[5].tolist()
sr_df=sr_raw.iloc[6:].copy()
sr_df.columns=sr_header
sr_df=sr_df.dropna(subset=['Payroll Line ID'])
sr_df['norm_cc']=sr_df['Cost Centre'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
sr_df['norm_status']=sr_df['Payroll Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
sr_df=sr_df[sr_df['norm_status']=='paid']
sr_df['Gross_num']=sr_df['Gross Salary (INR)'].apply(clean_money)
sr_merged=sr_df.merge(lookup_df, left_on='norm_cc', right_on='norm_code', how='inner')
sr_merged=sr_merged[(sr_merged['Programme'].str.strip().str.lower()=='maternal and child health') & (sr_merged['State'].str.strip().str.lower()=='odisha')]
total_sr=sr_merged['Gross_num'].sum()

print('FE count', len(fe_merged), 'sum', total_fe)
print('SR count', len(sr_merged), 'sum', total_sr)
print('Combined', total_fe+total_sr)
\"
